messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to ondansetron: rash, hives; fever, chills, difficult breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
- severe constipation, stomach pain, or bloating;
- sudden chest pain or chest tightness, severe dizziness, fainting, fast or pounding heartbeats;
- fast or pounding heartbeats;
- jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes);
- blurred vision or temporary vision loss (lasting from only a few minutes to several hours);
- high levels of serotonin in the body--agitation, hallucinations, fever, fast heart rate, overactive reflexes, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of coordination, fainting.
Common ondansetron side effects may include:
- diarrhea or constipation;
- headache;
- drowsiness; or
- tired feeling.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Ondansetron", "has allergic reaction symptom", "rash"]

The relation 'has allergic reaction symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the specific symptom specified by the object entity as part of an allergic reaction.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect variation': The occurrence or severity of side effects from the subject drug may be influenced by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
